title: NeoOrigins Origin Layer
description: A picker layer — ordered list of origin IDs the player can select from. File path: data/<namespace>/origins/origin_layers/<layer>.json. Use namespace=neoorigins, layer=origin to merge into the main picker tab.

origins.description: Ordered list of origin entries. First entry is the default selection. Each entry is either a plain origin ID string, an object pairing an origin ID with a layer condition that gates its visibility based on choices made in other layers, or a conditioned batch sharing one condition across several origin IDs.

name.description: Optional display name for this layer. Either a literal/translation-key string, or a text component object — LayerDataManager.normalizeLayerJson reads `translate`, else `text`, else falls back to the layer's path.

translate.description: Translation key, preferred over `text` when both are present.

text.description: Literal display text, used when there is no `translate`.

standalone.description: If true, this layer opts out of the same-path auto-merge — a foreign-namespace layer whose path is `origin` or `class` normally folds into neoorigins:origin / neoorigins:class so the picker shows one tab. Set true to keep it as its own tab. Default false.

order.description: Lower values render earlier in the picker. Default 0.

enabled.description: If false, the layer is loaded but skipped by the picker. Default true.

allow_random.description: If true, this layer participates in random-origin assignment. Default false.

default_origin.description: Origin ID auto-assigned when the layer is resolved without a player choice.

auto_choose.description: If true, the layer auto-selects when only one origin is available, skipping the picker screen for it. Default false.

hidden.description: If true, the layer is resolved but never shown as a picker tab. Default false.

replace.description: If true, this file fully replaces earlier definitions of the same layer ID from lower-priority datapacks. Default false (merge).

origin_entry_string.description: A bare origin ID, always visible.

origin_entry_object.description: One origin ID with an optional layer condition gating its visibility.

origin_batch.description: Conditioned batch: one condition shared by several origin IDs. LayerDataManager.normalizeLayerJson expands it into one entry per ID, copying the condition onto each, so it is pure shorthand for a run of origin_entry_object entries.

origins.description: Origin IDs the shared condition applies to. Nested entry objects are passed through untouched and keep their own condition instead.

layer_condition.description: Condition over the player's previous layer choices. Type namespaces origins:, apace: and neoorigins: are interchangeable.

layer.description: Layer whose choice is tested. Defaults to neoorigins:origin (the main origin layer).

origin.description: Origin that must have been chosen in that layer.

inverted.description: If true, passes when the origin was NOT chosen. Default false.

conditions.description: Sub-conditions: all must pass for and, any for or.
